69531cfe586e3e48.summary: Missed a mutual fund SIP payment? It never hurts your CIBIL score because mutual funds aren't loans, but your bank will charge ₹250–₹500 for NACH bounce fees. Hook: 'Your bank account didn't have money on SIP day: does it destroy your CIBIL score?'
69531cfe586e3e48.notes:
- Mutual funds are equity/debt investments, not credit facilities; AMCs never report missed SIPs to CIBIL or Experian
- Banks levy NACH/e-mandate ECS bounce charges ranging from ₹250 to ₹500 plus 18% GST per failed attempt
- AMCs will not cancel your SIP on one miss; cancellation occurs only after 3 consecutive failed debits
- Practical guide: pause SIP online 15-30 days prior rather than letting bank auto-debits bounce

74d3d7ceeab2bf5d.notes:
- EPFO rules clarify that inactive accounts continue earning statutory interest (currently 8.25%) until age 58
- However, under tax law, interest earned after employment ceases (when no fresh employee/employer contributions are made) is taxable as income from other sources
- Step-by-step UAN transfer online via EPFO portal (Form 13) consolidates past service for the 5-year continuous service tax exemption
- Vital guidance for young professionals switching jobs frequently
